Description: Unique sample identifier; used as the sample (column) names inside the counts and RPKM data files
Values_or_units: e.g. iPSC_626_1; iHSPC_626; iMono_626; iHep_113_2; iLC62_6_D21_neuron
Notes: Use this column to join meta data with counts and RPKM data. Format differs between cell types, and the case of cell line codes differs between sequencing runs (e.g. iHSPC_68BC5, iMono_68bc5), so do not reconstruct Sampleid from other columns

Description: Undifferentiated iPSC or iPSC-derived cell type
Values_or_units: undifferentiated_iPSC; iHSPC; iMonocytes; iHepatocytes; iNeurons; iAstrocytes
Notes: The i- prefix denotes iPSC-derived cells. iMonocytes were differentiated from iHSPCs

Values_or_units: e.g. iLC 62-6; iLD 7-6; LC 68BC-5; iC4-4; UWWC1-DS1
Notes: LC = D21 control donor; LD = donor with Down syndrome. Lines derive from individual Human Trisome Project donors, except the isogenic pair iLD 11#3 (D21) and iLD 11(2)-1 (T21), derived from the same donor with mosaic T21. iC4-4 and UWWC1-DS1 are used for iNeurons and iAstrocytes only. Names harmonized to the format used in the other datasets (see Comment)

Description: Chromosome 21 status of the iPSC line
Notes: D21 = disomic (euploid); T21 = trisomy 21. D21 is the reference level

Description: Replicate number for the cell line within a cell type and sequencing run
Donor cell type reprogrammed to generate the iPSC line
Notes: Renal epithelial cells were obtained from urine samples

Description: iPSC passage number at the start of differentiation
iPSC passage number recorded at harvest
Kits and factors used for differentiation
Total days in differentiation at harvest
Notes: NA for undifferentiated iPSCs; iMonocytes include 12 days of iHSPC differentiation

Description: GEO SubSeries accession holding the counts and RPKM data for the sample's cell type
Notes: SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE347972, except iHepatocytes (GSE296449, previously reported)

Description: Sample title as used in GEO
Notes: Cell line names as originally recorded
ALL-CAPS comments flag rows for review (e.g. renamed cell lines); NA if none
